title: OpenTelemetry tool-event export: raw stdout must not reach the exporter
reason_not_testable: Telemetry export captures tool output outside the hook path; a PostToolUse hook changes only model-visible output and no fixture kind observes the exporter or collector. Control: non-hook check that tool-output content is disabled in the telemetry export or redacted at the collector (exact settings UNVERIFIED on 2.1.296).
